name: porsche-design-system-analyzer
description: Analyzes websites for Porsche Design System compliance

scripts.build: npm run catalog && node -e "require('fs').readdirSync('.').filter(f=>/^porsche-design-system-analyzer(-v.*)?-chrome\.zip$/.test(f)).forEach(f=>require('fs').unlinkSync(f))" && wxt build
scripts.deploy: npm run catalog && wxt zip && node -e "const v=require('./package.json').version,fs=require('fs'),g=fs.readdirSync('.').filter(f=>/^porsche-design-system-analyzer(-v.*)?-chrome\.zip$/.test(f));g.forEach(f=>fs.unlinkSync(f));fs.copyFileSync('.output/porsche-design-system-analyzer-'+v+'-chrome.zip','./porsche-design-system-analyzer-v'+v+'-chrome.zip');const r=fs.readFileSync('README.md','utf8').replace(/porsche-design-system-analyzer-v[^)]+\.zip/,'porsche-design-system-analyzer-v'+v+'-chrome.zip');fs.writeFileSync('README.md',r);"
